checkpoint_selection: pre-existing v5 C_shared_masked validation winner, no reselection
architecture: ProtT5 shared q/v LoRA r8 + residue mean pooling + LN/256 GELU/6 sigmoid head
primary: per-task Mars minus base score on reference original label=1; six separate effects
secondary: six-dimensional Euclidean distance to reference probability vector; diagnostic not aggregate activity score
inherited_labels: reference annotations define strata only; not ground-truth design labels

uncertainty.resampling_unit: union of reference registered ID50 and relation components
uncertainty.multiple_testing: BH across six component-mean sign-flip primary tests; 20000 permutations

sentinel: compare 32 length-spaced validation records with saved probabilities before inference; max absolute tolerance 0.002
inference: float16 autocast, batch1, no truncation, no training, deduplicate exact sequences
limitation: single generated sample per backbone and unequal generation seeds; training exposure audited, not independent validation
